text:
ashok: quick check — need a compact rack slot for a weekend loadtest, ideally A100 x4 in us-west2 for Sat-Sun. Can we get a stand-by borrow or a short reserved window?

sam: can you paste the runtime / expected qps and frag? helps pick between reserved vs burst.

ashok: target is 2k RPS sustained for 2 hours, mostly inference. seq len ~512, kv-cache warmup expected. budgeted for burst pool but want lower latency for a production sim.

maria: do we have an existing ticket with procurement? vendor portal has limited compact racks this week. Link: https://vendor.example.com/allocs/12345 — says available in us-west2 but needs approval.

chris: FYI finance prefers stand-by borrow for <48h to avoid long-term commit. If this is critical for release smoke, we can approve one-time.

ashok: prefer borrow to avoid commit. we'll run smoke + perf baseline, then teardown. tagging PR that adds the test harness: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4567

sam: assign me to handle the portal request. I'll open the approval and ask vendor for a short SLA. Can you drop the terraform label you want?

ashok: terraform snippet for alloc label — use this when you file the request: ```hcl
resource "vendor_alloc" "compact_weekend" {
  region = "us-west2"
  sku = "A100-40GB"
  count = 4
  start = "2024-06-29T00:00:00Z"
  end = "2024-06-30T12:00:00Z"
  tags = ["prod-sim","short-burst","team-inference"]
}
```

vendor-bot: allocation request created in vendor portal (#req-7782). Pending approval from procurement and on-call infra. Link: https://vendor.example.com/requests/7782

maria: quick note — if vendor needs quota increase on our cloud account, open cloud console ticket now. I saw a quota soft-limit for A100 in us-west2 for our project.

chris: Sam — also ping @security briefly to confirm no special network posture required for this test. We used isolated VPC previously.

sam: on it. Filing cloud quota request and security ping. Will update here when both approve. ETA 2-3h. :thumbsup:

ashok: thanks. one more ask — if approval comes late, is a partial borrow (2x A100) acceptable for the baseline run?

maria: yes, we can scale the test down to 2 GPUs to validate latency curves, then run full 4 if everything looks good.

vendor-bot: procurement approved request #req-7782 (temp borrow). Vendor ETA: provision in 90 minutes.

sam: cloud quota increase granted for A100 in us-west2 (+4 GPUs) — console ticket #CQ-3321. Security also ACK'd network isolation.

ashok: awesome, schedule is green. I'll kick off the harness at 09:00 PT Saturday and tag this thread with final teardown. Thanks all. :rocket:

chris: nice work — leaving sam as owner for postmortem notes.

ashok: closing loop — teardown complete, racks released. Perf numbers uploaded to the shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/inference/perf/2024-06-29-compact-run.csv

sam: confirmed teardown and vendor release. Marking request #req-7782 closed. :white_check_mark:

maria: adding a quick follow-up: create a short runbook for future weekend borrows so we can reduce approval time. I'll draft and ping for reviews.

ashok: will write the runbook and link the terraform snippet + checklist to the infra runbooks repo.

chris: great — thanks everyone.
